backend: llama.cpp b12110 CUDA; native GGUF inference, fp32 block-output edits; 32 text blocks
dev_gate: At least 6/8 pairs must give the correct full-vocabulary top-1 answer at both queries. Score every test pair regardless of capability.
destination: Last prompt position, immediately before first answer token in native non-thinking format. Save every final block position too.
counterfactual: Replace one fact's color with a third color in an aligned donor; patch its one-token source at block output. Same displacement in relevant and irrelevant query, with identical token distance. Alternate first and second fact as source.
primary: At epsilon=1, one-sided change from clean in donor-minus-original first-answer-token logit margin for relevant query minus the corresponding change for irrelevant query. Mean across all 32 test prefixes; paired 95% percentile interval from 10000 prefix resamples.
controls: Repeat clean and use one matched-norm isotropic random direction per prefix at epsilon=1, shared across its two queries. All signed edits, epsilon=0.05 donor, per-lag and query-dependent residuals are secondary. Balanced edit location and prespecified held-out template/name bank.
interpretation: A paired response to a finite edit in the quantized checkpoint. No inference about a particular head, exact derivative, free generation, or transfer to other checkpoints.
